title: rsmodel: a resilience-symptom dynamical model of depression
description:
Reference implementation and interactive companion of the resilience–symptom (RS) model, a qualitative two-state dynamical model of the interaction between depressive symptoms and psychological resilience under external adversity.

The repository contains the installable rsmodel Python package, three marimo notebooks (interactive playground, symbolic analysis, figure generation) and the tooling that publishes the playground as a WebAssembly application at rsmodel.org.

Warning: neither the model nor its time scale is calibrated against clinical data. This is a qualitative model, not a quantitative one, it does not represent the effects of medication or of any other intervention, and it is not a diagnostic or clinical tool.
